## Type

- [ ] New rule (`rules/`)
- [ ] Rule accuracy fix
- [ ] SDK / CLI change

## Checklist

- [ ] `aitdp rules test` and `pytest python/tests` pass locally
- [ ] New rules include `tests.match` **and** `tests.no_match` samples and references
- [ ] Spec changes are backwards compatible (or the version was bumped and CHANGELOG updated)
